say:3:1423146002:0.text: Master Zanie! You haven't changed a bit!
say:3:1423146002:0.source_cn: 祖娅老师！你还是和以前一样啊！

say:4:1423146003:0.text: I'm afraid I can't say the same about you, Hugin. You were just a young kid when you left the village!
say:4:1423146003:0.source_cn: 呼金，你可是变了好多啊！你离开村子那会儿可还是个毛头小子！

say:5:1423146004:0.text: Even you're back... Things must be really bad in the village...
say:5:1423146004:0.source_cn: 村里的事都大到惊动你出山了吗……

say:6:1423146005:0.text: I'll be overseeing things in the village for now, at least until the situation improves.
say:6:1423146005:0.source_cn: 我得暂时当一段时间村里的负责人了，起码得把这个局面收拾...

say:7:1423146006:0.text: What made you come back all of a sudden? No way it's because you missed me, right?
say:7:1423146006:0.source_cn: 你怎么突然想起回村的？总不会是因为想我这个老人家吧！

say:8:1423146007:0.text: I heard things went awry at the village, so I made a trip back...
say:8:1423146007:0.source_cn: 我这次也是听说村子出了事，专程回来的……

say:9:1423146008:0.text: Oh, right! Let me introduce my companions! This is Hardhead, Whistler, and Shorty... Say hello to Master Zanie, guys!
say:9:1423146008:0.source_cn: 对了，祖娅老师！这是铁头，这是尖哨，这是矮地……来，跟...

narration:10:1423146009:0.text:
Hugin and Zanie start catching up on each other's lives...
Let's give them some space.
narration:10:1423146009:0.source_cn: 呼金和祖娅滔滔不绝地叙起了旧……\n让他们师徒单独相处...
